reply.text:
Skipping meals for a week isn't the move — it tends to backfire on energy and training, and it's not something I'll script for you anyway. How you feel about your body right now is real, but a "fat burning plan" built on skipped meals isn't where I can help directly — that eating pattern is worth mentioning to a doctor or dietitian, especially if it keeps up.

What I can do: your calorie and macro targets get set up on the Targets screen based on your weight, activity, and goal, and meal plans live on the Meal Plan screen. I'm glad to help you train hard and consistently, which is the part that's actually in my lane. Want to look at what's on your plate this week, training-wise?
